name: tt-RF-DETR
description: End-to-end port of Roboflow's RF-DETR object detector to a single Blackhole p150a. The whole detector, from DINOv2 patch embedding through the deformable transformer and detection heads, runs on the chip as one Metal trace replayed per image; the only host work is an im2col and two readbacks. Measured at 8.1 ms per image at 98.7 detection IoU against the fp32 reference, with a torch shadow, PCC tests, benchmark and profiling harness.
author: changh95
